title: An Enhanced 16nm CMOS Technology Featuring 2nd Generation FinFET Transistors and Advanced Cu/Low-k Interconnect for Low Power and High Performance Applications
lineage: PDF mirror of the original IEEE conference paper. The authors developed the process.

passages.locator: Paper 3.1.1, Abstract, Process Architecture, Transistor Performance, and reference [1]
passages.note: TSMC authors describe a second generation of their 16 nm technology with revised FinFETs and copper/low-k interconnect, and compare measured circuits to their 2013 16 nm work. The paper leaves the commercial process name unspecified.
